 Sixers take table-topping squad to Adelaide for Strikers match
 Sixers take table-topping squad to Adelaide for Strikers match ©Sydney Sixers Media 
 By Cricket World & Sydney Sixers 
 Monday 16 November 2026 
 Women's Big Bash League 
 Women T20 series Schedule 25th Match, Adelaide Live Adelaide Strikers Women 34/1 4.1 ov Sydney Sixers Women AS-W elected to bat
 Adelaide Strikers Women elected to bat
 Live scores and commentary 
 Sydney Sixers will take an unchanged squad to Adelaide for their WBBL meeting with the Strikers at Karen Rolton Oval. The Sixers enter the match at the top of the standings after six wins.
 Sydney Sixers Women will travel to Adelaide ahead of their Women's Big Bash League match against Adelaide Strikers Women at Karen Rolton Oval on November 17.
 The Sixers have retained the same squad for the contest, which is scheduled to begin at 7.10pm EDT.
 They head into the fixture at the top of the WBBL standings , level with Perth Scorchers on six victories but holding first place through their superior net run rate.
 Sydney Sixers squad against Adelaide Strikers
 Ash Gardner (captain), Caoimhe Bray, Erin Burns, Alice Capsey , Lauren Cheatle, Sarah Coyte, Sophia Dunkley, Amelia Kerr , Grace Lyons, Frankie Nicklin, Ellyse Perry , Eva Ragg and Courtney Sippel.
 Unavailable players
 Maddy Darke remains unavailable through injury, while Maitlan Brown and Elsa Hunter have been omitted from the travelling squad.
